title: Washed out looking print
text:
Washed out looking print. For the 65 dollars i spent these curtains SHOULD OF HAD A CLEARER PICTURE. The tiger looks washed out. The scenery looks DIGITAL. Maybe worth 40.00 not 65.00 plus tax!
Also the length should of been wider with that hefty price.
They need to drop the price down. For the fact that the curtains look washed out and foggy.
I also hung a smaller curtain behind this one to keep the sun out as these curtains are not black out curtains. There not sheer but there not black out. If that makes sense.
Anyway i give these curtains 3 out of 5.
As i didnt like how dim the tiger looks. Or how digital the scene was. Like badly photo shopped.
Might keep them as it matches my safari cheetah print rug. But wish i knew before hand the cons.
